classification: Calibrated skin-contact, passive axial support and task-guided planar torque-driven experiment; estimated mechanics, not measured dinosaur biology

optimization.acceleration_weight_note: Only active for the optional implicit formulation. Explicit mode retains activation dynamics and bounded controls.

provenance.geometry: Fresh semantic joint centers from admitted source geometry; bilateral segment lengths averaged and projected into a planar chain
provenance.mass: Animal-instance body_mass measurement retains original source and confidence
provenance.segment_distribution_inertia_capacity_co: Explicit authored estimates for feasibility, not measured or fitted biological values. Rod and ellipsoid approximations. Sensitivity and calibration pending.
provenance.task: Soft world-space foot-region tracking from periodic analytic support/recovery task. No knee tracking or previous motion clip. Duty .43 is extant-transfer prior RUN-OSTRICH-2007, not a Tarbo measurement; clearance and axial posture are authored calibration targets.
provenance.implementation_reference: OpenSim Moco public optimal-control and periodicity APIs; original project model builder; no imported dinosaur trajectories or third-party dinosaur model code
provenance.contact: Five spheres fit to actual admitted skinned sole envelope; added distal toe articulation. Compliance, material margin and radius remain engineering estimates.
provenance.passive: Internal generalized spring/damper torques with explicitly estimated stiffness/rest angles. These are not reconstructed muscles or ligaments.
provenance.release: Nonzero heel angular velocity passes from late support into recovery. Soft task only. Distal angular acceleration is regularized at 1e-6 s^4; neither joint-angle schedule nor biological muscle model.
